The plate looks like a square side plate of roughly 22 cm. It holds scrambled egg whites (or a similar egg dish) with a yellowish sauce, plus one strip of what is probably turkey bacon or a plant-based bacon.

I estimate the egg at about 150 g. Egg whites run roughly 50 kcal per 100 g, and scrambled eggs with some fat run about 150 kcal per 100 g. The egg looks pale and white, so I'll assume egg whites with a little oil, around 80 kcal per 100 g, which gives about 120 kcal for 150 g. The sauce adds perhaps 15 g and about 30 kcal. The bacon strip is about 10 g and adds about 45 kcal.

That comes to roughly 165 kcal from the egg and sauce combined with the bacon, so about 195 kcal in total. The total mass is about 175 g.
